faq.a: No. No residential housing mix was confirmed on the island; the Delta Official Community Plan treats the island as industrial land, home to the Annacis Business Park, the Port of Vancouver auto terminal and Metro Vancouver's wastewater treatment plant.

faq.q: How is the island reached by road?
faq.a: By Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge via the Cliveden Interchange, with park access via Chester Road / Audley Boulevard and Cliveden Avenue, as shown on the TransLink 340 route description.

faq.q: What is the Annacis Auto Terminal?
faq.a: It is the Port of Vancouver's vehicle terminal at 820 Dock Road on Annacis Island, operated by Wallenius Wilhelmsen; the port authority's optimization project consolidated the Annacis and Richmond auto terminals there, lifting capacity to 480,000 vehicles annually.

faq.q: Is there a bus route serving the island?
faq.a: Route 340 runs between Scottsdale Exchange and 22nd Street Station via Highway 91 and the Cliveden Interchange, serving the industrial area edge; no bus exchange on the island itself was confirmed.

faq.q: Which plan governs land use on the island?
faq.a: The Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400, which covers land use across Delta including industrial areas; port-terminal land is also subject to Vancouver Fraser Port Authority permitting.
